controls.observed: opacity .35 and pointer-events:none, but title stays 'Delete' and nothing explains why it is unavailable

controls.label: Clear-X inside every filter trigger
controls.observed: CRITICAL, measured with elementFromPoint: .custom-select-trigger uses justify-content:space-between with three children, so the clear-X lands at the HORIZONTAL CENTRE of the control (trigger 542px wide, X at x=769–789, centre=789). elementFromPoint(centre) returns 'canton-clear' / 'tu-clear'. Consequence: once a filter has a value, clicking the middle of the control — the natural way to reopen it — wipes the selection instead of opening the panel. Verified on Kantone (state ['AG'] → [], label back to 'All cantons', panel does not open) and on TU's (['BLS'] → []). Nothing tells the user the value was destroyed.

controls.label: Cascade between filters
controls.observed: picking cantons/TUs did not visibly narrow the Linien list in the recon

controls.label: Summary card
controls.observed: Type / Time Period / Filters, with the filter list concatenated without separators: 'RPV: Tarifverbund ATransport Mode: Bahn NormalspurCantons: AGLines: Bus 10Stops: Aarau'

controls.label: Schedule toggle row
controls.observed: clicking the row now flips the checkbox; with the Custom period selected the toggle is disabled and an amber note explains why

controls.label: Frequency select
controls.observed: switching frequency swaps the correct 'Run on' block

controls.label: Run Now (with the schedule box ticked)
controls.observed: toast reads 'Evaluation started — running now' and the app returns to the list. Nothing in the confirmation mentions the schedule that was just configured, and the new schedule does not appear in Geplante Berichte. A user cannot tell whether the schedule was saved.

controls.label: Pause / resume
controls.observed: works both ways: status Active→Paused→Active, action title Pause→Resume. BUT the 'Next Run' column still shows 01.06.2026 while the report is paused — a paused schedule advertises a next run that will not happen.

controls.label: Edit a scheduled report
controls.observed: opens the wizard with the schedule's name in the title and a 'Scheduled' badge, but NONE of the saved configuration is loaded: state.selectedPeriod resets to 'cur_month', TU/cantons/lines are all empty. The screen claims to be editing 'Fahrtausfälle DPM – Wöchentlich' while showing a blank default config, and the schedule section itself is hidden so the frequency cannot be seen or changed.

controls.label: Row actions
controls.observed: Pause / Edit / Delete only — no way to open the last produced report from here, and no 'run now'
